title: More Words Than Reality

sourceEvidence.locator: Why fluent research creates a new problem
sourceEvidence.excerpt: The book begins from an unsettling feature of AI-assisted inquiry: a capable model can rapidly produce nearly every outward sign of mature research. It can name a theory, draw an architecture, write equations and code, generate tests, survey literature, propose experiments, and compose a skeptical review. These artifacts may be useful, yet their abundance weakens the old connection between visible effort and encounters with reality. The central concern is not simple hallucination, where a fabricated citation can be checked. It is the coherent package in which the sentences are plausible, the mathematics is legal, and the software runs, but the work has not established what it appears to establish. sourceEvidence.locator: The Reality Gap and counterfeit maturity
sourceEvidence.excerpt: The Reality Gap names the distance between perceived maturity and maturity that survives relevant independent checks. A project can widen this gap by drifting from its original problem, proving a weakened statement, validating a simulation only against its own assumptions, or generating tests from the same misunderstanding that produced the code. Multiple agents do not necessarily solve the problem: if they share models, prompts, retrieval sources, specifications, or evaluative habits, their agreement can multiply one blind spot. The book distinguishes validation within a representation from validation of that representation. A proof assistant can certify a derivation without deciding whether the theorem faithfully expresses the intended question. sourceEvidence.locator: Rigor, formalism, and contact with reality
sourceEvidence.excerpt: The critique does not treat abstraction as fraud or mathematics as mere decoration. Instead, it asks what each formal achievement actually warrants. Mathematical validity, computational execution, reproducibility, empirical adequacy, practical feasibility, and confirmation of a physical interpretation are distinct accomplishments. A beautiful formalism can be valuable even when its bridge to observation remains disputed; conversely, runnable code can reproduce an answer while leaving novelty or causal interpretation unresolved. The book uses difficult areas such as theoretical physics, quantum computing, machine learning, simulation, and software verification to resist two symmetrical mistakes: symbol worship and anti-theoretical dismissal. The proposed alternative is Executable Science. The scientific paper remains indispensable as a compressed public argument, but it becomes one human-readable view of a richer, versioned research object. Beneath the narrative sit questions, hypotheses, claims, assumptions, datasets, code, protocols, negative results, uncertainty, reviewer objections, value conflicts, and the events that changed a conclusion. Stable identity and provenance make dependencies inspectable: which data version produced a figure, which assumption supports a mechanism claim, which model proposed a transition, and whether five apparent sources descend from one generated paragraph. This is progressive rather than universal formalization.
